requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting HINFO RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent HINFO RDATA as the CPU field followed by the OS field.
requirements.why_checkable: The HINFO serializer and parser field sequence can be checked against the depicted two-field layout.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting HINFO RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the CPU field as a <character-string>.
requirements.why_checkable: The CPU field serializer and parser can be inspected for character-string encoding.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting HINFO RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the CPU field as specifying the CPU type.
requirements.why_checkable: The association between the decoded CPU field and the CPU-type value can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
3.3.2. HINFO RDATA format

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                      CPU                      /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                       OS                      /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

CPU             A <character-string> which specifies the CPU type.

OS              A <character-string> which specifies the operating
                system type.
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting HINFO RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the OS field as a <character-string>.
requirements.why_checkable: The OS field serializer and parser can be inspected for character-string encoding.
